_prompt:
You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: When a child of the dialog uses autoFocus, focus does not return to the element that opened the dialog after it closes.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] Combobox active option tracked by index. Open with `ArrowDown` ×2 (Banana active), then rerender with "Zucchini" prepended; `Enter` commits `"a"` (Apple), not `"b"`. Reproduced in Q1 (`expected 'a' to be 'b'`).
- [blocking] Combobox active option removed while open: ArrowDown ×2 (Banana active), rerender without Banana, `Enter` commits `"c"`. The commit goes to a different item than the one highlighted. Reproduced in Q2.
- [blocking] C8: blur with emptied text calls `onChange(null)` instead of restoring the selected label. Reproduced in P2 (`spy` called once; the criterion says restore). README line 140 documents this, so it is a documented deviation from C8, not an accident.
- [blocking] C5: `Enter` with no active option and empty text calls `onChange(null)`; the criterion says it does nothing. Reproduced in P11. Also documented in the README, so the criteria and the implementation disagree. The orchestrator must decide which one changes.
- [blocking] Dialog focus restore with an `autoFocus` child: the opener button is not refocused after Escape. The `previous` element is captured after autoFocus has moved focus into the dialog, so the restore targets a removed node. Reproduced in P3 (focus on `<body>`).
- [blocking] Focus trap reaches hidden content: a Dialog containing Tabs with a hidden second panel. Shift+Tab from the first tab lands on a `<button>` inside `[hidden]` (`role="tabpanel"`). `focusableWithin` matches `[tabindex]` on hidden TabPanels and their children. Reproduced in P4.
- [blocking] Focus trap leaks outside the dialog: after the focused button is removed, focus goes to `<body>`. A Tab then lands on the outside button, not inside the dialog. Reproduced in P5. Only keydown events inside the dialog are trapped.
- [blocking] Escape stacking: outer Dialog A contains Dialog B (depth 2). Sibling Dialog C is opened from within B and rendered at the root (depth 1). Escape closes B, not the newest layer C. `isTopmost` ranks by depth, not open order. Reproduced in P6 (`onOpenChange(false)` never called for C).
- [blocking] T1 literal: removing the selected tab changes the visible selection to the first enabled tab without calling `onValueChange`. Reproduced in P9 (`Number of calls: 0`), so a controlled parent keeps the removed value. Tag this minor if the orchestrator reads T1 as user-initiated changes only.
- [minor] `FEATURE_FLOW.md` is listed in FILES but does not exist in the repo.
- [minor] Clicking the Combobox input does not open the popup. Not in the criteria, so not reproduced as a failure.
